title: Multi Skilled Engineer
description:
Position: Multi-skilled Shift Engineer

Location: Peterborough

Salary: £53,500 - £55,000

Shift: Days and Nights

About the role:

We are seeking a reliable and multi-skilled Shift Engineer to join our team on. The ideal candidate would be confident in both mechanical and electrical disciplines. PLC and inverter experience would also be an advantage. You will need to be self-sufficient and proactive and work well alone or as part of a team.

The role will require you to repair and maintain a variety of extrusion, chocolate coating and bakery equipment. This work includes breakdown repairs, machine servicing and improvement projects.

This role is on a Continental 3’s & 2’s pattern. working days and nights rotating

Key responsibilities

  • Carry out maintenance of factory equipment (both mechanical and electrical) in line with the routine maintenance schedule.
  • Follow and complete the Jobs Log during shift.
  • Maintain and update the MVP (CMMS) system.
  • Perform equipment repairs and deal with breakdowns.
  • Liaise with production teams to minimise downtime caused by engineering work.
  • Install and commission new equipment.
  • Manage assigned tasks effectively.
  • Support and assist external contractors while on site.
  • Complete assigned projects as agreed.
  • Attend all required statutory training.

Aptitudes required for this role

  • Perform other reasonable duties and responsibilities as required.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with strong customer orientation
  • The ability to integrate and work effectively with others in a changing environment.
  • Ability to multi-task, prioritize and manage time effectively.
  • High level of attention to detail, strong organizational, analytical, problem solving and administrative skills
  • An experienced team player
  • A strong desire for continuous learning and a desire to grow professionally.

Qualifications and skills

  • A recognised electrical/mechanical qualification (NVQ level 3 or equivalent)
  • Computer skills (A knowledge of CMMS systems and Excel, word, outlook etc.)
  • IET wiring regulations (18th edition)
  • Previous knowledge and use of an automated maintenance system
  • IPAF licence (3a), although training can be provided if required
